description:
Record every edge of the requested pins (probes of the setup sheet; by default the logic ones) for duration_ms
    (1 to 10 000 ms). In the browser's simulation, in simulated time; during the session's turn on a real bench, at the
    bench's logic analyser, in real time (no browser or running simulation needed then). trigger {pin, edge}: pin among
    pins, edge rising, falling or any; the recording then lasts wait_ms + duration_ms (10 000 ms at most) and keeps
    pre_ms (0 to wait_ms) before the first matching edge within wait_ms and duration_ms after it; with no such edge,
    the whole recording. Read the result with read_capture, decode it with decode_capture.
name: capture_logic
title: Capture logic signals
